title: Retrieval upgrades on real documents
note: 11 RFCs, 20 hand-labelled questions, K=5. The first six rows are before reranking (deterministic); the last three add the LLM reranker over 20 candidates (3 runs, mean ± sd). Headers = contextual chunk headers; websearch = websearch_to_tsquery with an OR top-up.
rows: Lexical only · OR search · plain chunks

title: Lexical search modes on the synthetic corpus
note: 72 questions, no LLM calls. Trigram matching is poor on its own for long natural-language questions and was not tried on the RFC set; OR-with-length-normalisation gave no gain.

title: Neighbour (parent-document) expansion
note: Real documents, answers without the agent loop, 3 runs, headers + websearch. Each retrieved chunk is handed to the answerer together with the chunk before and after it. Full-hit is measured on the expanded text, so it is not comparable with the K=5 rows above; answer accuracy is the fair comparison.

title: Iterative retrieval: 1 vs 3 follow-up searches
note: Multi-part questions only, agent loop. More hops did not help: on real documents full-hit fell and latency doubled; on the synthetic set there was no gain. One follow-up remains the default.
